in_marathi.name: Lakhan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of wealth or fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lakhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lakhan is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Lakshana’, which means ‘sign’, ‘symbol’, or ‘mark’. In Hindu mythology, Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth, fortune, and prosperity, is often depicted with a lotus flower in her hand, which symbolizes the seed of creation and abundance. Lakhan is a masculine name that evokes a sense of prosperity, wealth, and good fortune.
